guidance_items.text: Match the structure of names, not specific names: use patterns like [A-ZÄÖÜ][a-zäöüß]+ instead of listing concrete company, city or office names.
Precision comes first: since German capitalizes all nouns, every rule needs a strong context anchor (e.g. a legal form like GmbH/AG/KG, or a keyword like 'Finanzamt').
Aim for creating generic rules. White list rules should be created only in cases when it cannot be generalized.
